title: Apply warm beige marble global background with dark overlay across all pages

requirements.text: Set the global body background color to a warm beige marble tone (#DCCBB5) across the entire application by updating the global stylesheet (frontend/src/index.css). This must apply to all pages: Home, Technical Events, Non-Technical Events, Register, Payment, Success, Contact, Admin, and Dashboard.

quotes: Change the entire website background on all pages (Home, Technical, Non-Technical, Register, Contact, Admin Dashboard) to a warm beige marble-style background color similar to #DCCBB5.
Apply this background globally using body styling so it affects the entire app.

acceptanceCriteria: The body element has a background-color of #DCCBB5 or equivalent warm beige marble tone applied globally.
All pages (Home, Technical, Non-Technical, Register, Payment, Success, Contact, Admin, Dashboard) show the beige marble background.
No page retains the previous dark/black background at the body level.

requirements.text: Add a full-viewport fixed dark overlay element with background rgba(0,0,0,0.75) and z-index below all page content (z-index: 0 or equivalent) so that neon/orange glowing elements remain visually premium and text stays readable against the beige background. This overlay must not block any interactions or sit above any content layer.

quotes: Ensure text readability by adding a very subtle dark overlay (rgba(0,0,0,0.75)) above the background so the glowing orange elements still look premium.

acceptanceCriteria: A fixed full-viewport pseudo-element or overlay div with background rgba(0,0,0,0.75) is rendered above the body background but below all page content.
Orange neon glow effects and text remain fully visible and unobstructed.
No buttons, inputs, links, or interactive elements are blocked by the overlay.
The overlay covers 100vw × 100vh on all pages.

requirements.text: Ensure that all existing layout, spacing, font sizes, animations, neon highlights, circuit patterns, CountdownTimer, Navbar, Footer, and all functional components remain completely unchanged. Only global background styling is modified.

quotes: Keep all existing layout, content, animations, neon highlights, and design unchanged.
Do not modify any section spacing, font sizes, buttons, or functionality.
Only change the global background styling.

acceptanceCriteria: No changes are made to any page component files beyond global CSS.
All animations (PhoenixIntro, LoadingScreen, CountdownTimer, CircuitPattern) continue to function as before.
Section spacing, font sizes, button styles, and layout are identical to the previous version.
Neon orange glow effects remain visually intact.

constraints: Do not modify any page component files (Home.tsx, TechnicalEvents.tsx, NonTechnicalEvents.tsx, Register.tsx, Contact.tsx, Admin.tsx, Dashboard.tsx, etc.).
Do not alter section spacing, font sizes, button styles, or any functional logic.
The dark overlay must not intercept pointer events or block any interactive elements.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui/.
nonGoals: Changing typography, font sizes, or layout structure.
Modifying neon glow colors or animation behavior.
Updating backend logic or data models.
